interpretation.event_claim: none; this is support diagnosis only

destination_definition.destination_role: resting basin liquid and post-contact destination volume

contact.definition: first downward crossing from z>0.18 to z<=0.18 after t=0

event_definition.path_interpolation: native support particle positions are linearly interpolated between the two registered reference frames; interval-start native velocity is held for the causal query; the independent tracer path is integrated by RK2 substeps

post_return_window.extension_policy: one whole-scope doubling only when an event is right-censored; a source ending at 4.34 s cannot claim the 8.68 s extension

residence.definition: time in the continuous destination box after contact

return.definition: first later downward crossing after upward from z>0.18 to z<=0.18

upward_propagation.definition: first upward crossing after contact from z<=0.18 to z>0.18

provider_contract.model: must provide only current predicted x/v state and public parameters; no future CFD density/state
provider_contract.reference: may read only the two native support frames bracketing the current interval

f4_definition.seed_identity: independent geometric seed-XXXXXX ids; never native particle_id

source_definition.source_role: falling liquid drop, initial fluid box

f4_definition.source_labels: continuous initial source-box membership; native Mk and particle_id are provenance only
